metadata.question: Does Houston show higher nighttime light intensity in December 2012 and 2013 compared to the average light output during other months from 2012 to 2014?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: VIIRS Nighttime Lights (VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG) for 2012-2014 - Date: December 2012 & 2013 vs. other months (Jan-Nov 2012, Jan-Nov 2013, Jan-Dec 2014) - Location: Houston, Texas area (approximately -95.3698°W, 29.7604°N) 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for nighttime lights - Use the 'avg_rad' band which contains calibrated average radiance values - Filter out low-quality data if necessary 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Houston should have positive nighttime light values, so 0 would indicate data issues - Check if collections have images - Check if pixel counts > 0 after processing - Check if radiance values are valid (should be positive for urban areas) - Compare December avg vs. other months avg ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Houston geometry const houston = ee.Geometry.Point([-95.3698, 29.7604]).buffer(20000); // 20km radius // 2. Data Acquisition const collection = ee.ImageCollection('VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterBounds(houston) .select('avg_rad'); // December 2012 and 2013 const dec2012 = collection.filterDate('2012-12-01', '2012-12-31'); const dec2013 = collection.filterDate('2013-12-01', '2013-12-31'); // Other months (Jan-Nov 2012, Jan-Nov 2013, all 2014) const other2012 = collection.filterDate('2012-01-01', '2012-11-30'); const other2013 = collection.filterDate('2013-01-01', '2013-11-30'); const all2014 = collection.filterDate('2014-01-01', '2014-12-31'); // Check collection sizes const dec2012Size = dec2012.size().getInfo(); const dec2013Size = dec2013.size().getInfo(); const other2012Size = other2012.size().getInfo(); const other2013Size = other2013.size().getInfo(); const all2014Size = all2014.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Dec 2012: ${dec2012Size} images, Dec 2013: ${dec2013Size} images`); console.log(`Other 2012: ${other2012Size}, Other 2013: ${other2013Size}, All 2014: ${all2014Size} images`); if (dec2012Size === 0 || dec2013Size === 0 || (other2012Size + other2013Size + all2014Size) === 0) { console.log('Missing data for comparison periods.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Calculate mean values const decemberImages = dec2012.merge(dec2013); const otherImages = other2012.merge(other2013).merge(all2014); const decMean = decemberImages.mean(); const otherMean = otherImages.mean(); // 4. Reduce to region const decStats = decMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: houston, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const otherStats = otherMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: houston, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const decValue = decStats.avg_rad_mean; const decCount = decStats.avg_rad_count; const otherValue = otherStats.avg_rad_mean; const otherCount = otherStats.avg_rad_count; console.log(`December avg: ${decValue}, pixels: ${decCount}`); console.log(`Other months avg: ${otherValue}, pixels: ${otherCount}`); // 5. Validation & Answer if (decCount === 0 || otherCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (decValue === null || decValue === undefined || otherValue === null || otherValue === undefined) { console.log('Calculation returned invalid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (decValue > otherValue) { console.log(`December (${decValue.toFixed(2)}) > Other months (${otherValue.toFixed(2)})`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`December (${decValue.toFixed(2)}) <= Other months (${otherValue.toFixed(2)})`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
